claim: For delivery from Kinesis Data Streams to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets, the data freshness (maximum buffering time before records are delivered) can be set between 300 and 900 seconds (5 to 15 minutes). The default is 300 seconds. This feature is not examinable yet.
question: What buffering range does the Kinesis Data Streams direct S3 delivery allow, and what is the default?

qualifiers.scope: per S3 delivery of a data stream
qualifiers.condition: announced 2026-08-29 (after the cutoff), so not examinable yet; DataFreshnessInSeconds is one of two properties that can be updated

evidence.quote: Data freshness defines the maximum buffering time before records are delivered. You can configure this value between 300 and 900 seconds (5 to 15 minutes). The default is 300 seconds.

note: NOT EXAMINABLE YET (GA 2026-08-29). Compare Firehose S3 buffering of 0 to 900 seconds.

claim: Streaming tables and Amazon S3 delivery from Kinesis Data Streams require on-demand capacity mode and are not supported in provisioned mode. This feature is not examinable yet.
question: Does Kinesis Data Streams S3 delivery work for provisioned streams?

qualifiers.scope: Kinesis data streams, S3 delivery and streaming tables
qualifiers.condition: announced 2026-08-29 (after the cutoff), so not examinable yet

evidence.quote: Not supported. Streaming tables and Amazon S3 delivery require on-demand capacity mode.
